_schema.description: Pre-built actuators for legged robots. Use with --actuator-mode catalog. Specs reflect joint-side (post-gearbox) properties. Entries are ordered by increasing torque density (peak_torque / mass, N*m/kg). `index` is a GLOBAL index shared with catalogs/motors.json's `index` field -- the two files together form one combined motor+actuator torque-density ranking (motors are always lower since they're pre-gearbox), see catalogs/README.md for the merged table. Reference actuators by NAME in DesignSpec/variable_params.json, not index -- `index` is a readability label only and shifts whenever either file is edited.

units.index: [-] (0-based position in the COMBINED motors.json+actuators.json torque-density ranking -- not read by actuator.py's loader, purely for readability/cross-referencing with README.md)
units.Kt: N*m/A (motor torque constant, joint-side after gearbox if known; optional)
units.ratio: [-] (gear ratio; optional, used for power model fallback)
units.length: m (axial thickness / housing length along the rotation axis)

actuators.name: ODrive-D5065-DD
actuators.notes: Direct-drive D5065 motor; rotor diameter φ50mm, length 65mm.

actuators.name: TMotor-AK80-6

actuators.notes: MAB Robotics MD80 driver paired with AK80-6 class motor; dimensions 38.5mm depth.

actuators.name: ANYdrive-3

actuators.name: Bota-Roboticer-50
actuators.notes: Synthetic benchmark fallback entry (not a physical product).

actuators.name: Unitree-A1

actuators.name: TMotor-AK10-9

actuators.name: MIT-Cheetah-3

actuators.name: HEBI-X8-16

actuators.name: Unitree-B1
actuators.notes: Unitree B1 Knee Actuator; peak torque matches real B1 user manual spec (210 N*m). Length matches M107 architecture (74mm).
